beginner.title: Get started with UserTesting
beginner.outcome: You can: set up UserTesting, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Collect good data
beginner.outcome: You can: gather interviews, tests or responses
beginner.practice: Run or import two interviews or tests

beginner.title: Code and tag
beginner.practice: Code two transcripts with a simple codebook

intermediate.title: Find themes
intermediate.outcome: You can: turn codes into insights
intermediate.practice: Write three insight statements with evidence

intermediate.title: Survey and test design
intermediate.outcome: You can: design studies that answer the question
intermediate.practice: Design and pilot a short study

intermediate.title: Signature skills in UserTesting
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make UserTesting distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced UserTesting
expert.outcome: You can: use UserTesting's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Share and operationalise research
expert.outcome: You can: make insights usable by others

expert.title: Integrate UserTesting into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect UserTesting with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect UserTesting to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use UserTesting well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use UserTesting" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
